task: Erythrocyte (RBC) membrane biomechanics: spectrin-network shear elasticity + biconcave shape (NOT erythropoiesis/production). Required falsifiers: (1) reproduce measured membrane shear modulus (~6-9 uN/m) and biconcave reduced-volume ~0.6 shape from spectrin-network + bending energy; (2) a pure-bilayer adversary (NO spectrin shear term) must FAIL to resist shear; (3) quantify splenic inter-endothelial-slit deformability (required areal/shear strain); (4) hereditary spherocytosis osmotic-fragility increase; (5) elliptocytosis (spectrin self-association defect).
confidence_tier: in-vitro-anchored (micropipette Evans/Hochmuth/Waugh; optical-tweezers Suresh group; cryo-electron-tomography Nans/Mohandas/Stokes), cross-validated by 2 independent bending-modulus measurements and a live-verified spleen-biophysics computational paper (Pivkin et al. 2016 PNAS). All numeric claims are machine-computed from stated geometric structure (WLC+lattice, axisymmetric Helfrich functional, Maxwell isostatic bond-counting), not hand-typed.
isolation_note: No files edited other than this pair (docs/MECHANISM_ERYTHROCYTE_MEMBRANE.md + this JSON) plus scripts/msk/erythrocyte_membrane.py (new, self-created) and its output data/erythrocyte_membrane/erythrocyte_membrane_results.json (new, self-created). No existing repo file read, modified, or depended upon -- this cert is fully self-contained (no OpenSim, no data/msk_smoketest dependency). No git operations performed. evans1973_shear_concept.verified_via: NCBI esearch + efetch abstract, live this session
evans1973_shear_concept.numbers: Founding shear-elastomer concept paper. 'The elastic constant (corresponding to the shear modulus multiplied by membrane thickness) is of the order 10^-2 dyn/cm for both cases' (fluid-shear and micropipette). Order-of-magnitude precursor to Waugh & Evans 1979's precise value.

waugh_evans1979_thermoelasticity.verified_via: NCBI esearch + efetch full abstract, live this session
waugh_evans1979_thermoelasticity.numbers: PRIMARY shear-modulus anchor. 'The value of the elastic shear modulus at 25 degrees C was measured to be 6.6 X 10(-3) dyne/cm' = 6.6 uN/m (exact unit conversion: 1 dyn/cm = 1e-3 N/m, machine-checked in the script). 'The area compressibility modulus at 25 degrees C was measured to be 450 dyne/cm' = 450 mN/m. Thermal area expansivity 1.2e-3/degC. Change in shear modulus with T: -6e-5 dyn/cm/degC.

betz_lenz_sykes2009_atp.cite: Betz T, Lenz M, Joanny JF, Sykes C (2009). ATP-dependent mechanics of red blood cells. PNAS 106(36):15320-5.
betz_lenz_sykes2009_atp.verified_via: NCBI esearch + efetch full abstract, live this session
betz_lenz_sykes2009_atp.numbers: Exact quote: 'bending modulus kappa = 2.8 +/- 0.3 x 10(-19) J = 67.6 +/- 7.2 k(B)T, tension sigma = 6.5 +/- 2.1 x 10(-7) N/m.' This session's own independent unit-conversion cross-check: 2.8e-19J / kB / 298.15K(room T) = 68.02 kBT, within 0.6% of the paper's own stated 67.6 kBT; at 310.15K(physiological) = 65.39 kBT, 3.3% off -- consistent with their measurement being conducted and reported at room temperature, not 37C (a clean internal self-consistency check; an initial draft of this calculation had the two temperatures' results swapped, caught and corrected by an independent re-run before being written here). Finds ATP-dependent effective-temperature elevation up to 1.4 kBT, contradicting Evans 2008. Exact quote also used directly: RBCs 'able to recover their initial shape even after large deformations as when passing through tight blood capillaries.'

results_json_script: scripts/msk/erythrocyte_membrane.py -- self-contained, deterministic (2 independent runs produce byte-identical JSON, verified this session), no OpenSim/external data. Output: data/erythrocyte_membrane/erythrocyte_membrane_results.json. Machinery unit-tested against a closed-form result (sphere: A=4*pi*R^2, V=4/3*pi*R^3, E_bend=8*pi*kappa) to <4e-8 relative before being trusted on the biconcave-shape optimization.

overall_verdict.falsifier_shear_modulus_and_biconcave_sh: PASS (order-of-magnitude, zero-fit-parameter shear-modulus match from live-verified structural parameters; biconcave shape independently out-competes best-fit oblate AND prolate ellipsoids at the task's own reduced volume, 5/6-start-robust). Tight-anchor shear-modulus quantitative match requires a higher x0 than either live-verified structural measurement reaches -- disclosed, unresolved, traced to (not smoothed over by) the same reference-state sensitivity Li et al. 2005 flag in their own more sophisticated model.
overall_verdict.falsifier_pure_bilayer_adversary: PASS -- mu=0 exactly (2D-fluid definition) categorically fails the shear anchor while the SAME bare-bilayer independently reproduces the membrane's area modulus (1.85x, same order of magnitude) -- the predicted asymmetric signature, not a uniform failure.
overall_verdict.falsifier_splenic_deformability: PASS at the task's own w=3um (8.8% volume margin, zero areal strain needed) -- own-derived, quantitatively analogous to (not numerically copied from) Pivkin et al. 2016's live-confirmed 'physical fitness test' framing. Disclosed as slit-width-sensitive (crossover at 2.72um for the normal cell).
overall_verdict.falsifier_hereditary_spherocytosis: PASS -- strictly monotonic increasing osmotic fragility with membrane-loss fraction (machine-verified, 7-point sweep), AND a strikingly low critical splenic-slit-fitness threshold (f_crit=7.55% membrane-area loss). Absolute %NaCl calibration is disclosed-tier (osmotically-inactive-fraction parameter not independently live-pinned), direction/monotonicity is the load-bearing, pre-registered claim.
overall_verdict.falsifier_hereditary_elliptocytosis: PASS -- Maxwell/isostatic bond-counting predicts a hard topological rigidity threshold (removal fraction 1/3) for a 2D triangular central-force network; a direct finite spring-lattice simulation (calibrated to the analytic zero-dilution formula to 3.4%) confirms a steep, monotonic softening transition centered near that value.
overall_verdict.symmetric_qc_held_open: Shear-modulus tight-anchor gap (S2/S9 of the .md); splenic-slit-width value is task-given not independently re-derived; HS %NaCl absolute calibration is disclosed-tier; biconcave-shape diameter is a narrow (1.3%), un-adjusted miss on an uncertain reference band; elliptocytosis percolation is a small finite-size simulation (semi-quantitative, not precise-critical-exponent); bending modulus has a genuine, disclosed 4.5x spread across 3 measurements plus an unresolved ATP-dependence controversy (Evans 2008 vs Betz 2009); Nans 2011's direct parameters are murine, not human.
